title: Chapter 2716: Gaia’s True Identity(2)
content:
Chapter 2716: Gaia’s True Identity(2)

After a long moment of silence, Yu Rou finally spoke.

"Let’s say, for argument’s sake, that I believe you. Are you saying that I’m currently being manipulated by an Eternal? If so, what is their purpose? What do they stand to gain?"

Yuan shook his head. "That, I don’t know."

"Then let me tell you what I do know. Our city is what it is today because of this Eternal. It didn’t merely warn us about the inevitable invasion—it also prepared us for it."

"It taught us about cultivation and even gave us the system, allowing our civilization to advance at an incredible pace. Before receiving the Eternal’s guidance, our world was nowhere near this advanced. Hell, we didn’t even know cultivation existed."

Yu Rou released a deep sigh before continuing, "I don’t know what you’ve experienced, nor whether you’re even telling the truth, but I believe that whatever is behind me is not taking advantage of us."

"..."

A moment of silence later, Yuan asked, "What exactly were you told? And when did it start? I assume you called for me because you want me to help with the invasion. I don’t mind doing that, but I need to understand the situation fully, as there are still many things I do not understand about this world and its situation."

"I won’t beat around the bush," Yu Rou said. "We need your power, and as you’ve already guessed, we need it to repel the invaders. If you’re willing to lend us your strength, I’ll tell you everything."

"G-Gaia... That may be—"

"Supreme General, this is no longer a matter of whether we can trust him or not. I didn’t tell you this earlier, but I received another message right before the invasion began. It showed me the future—what kind of power the Celestial Beings are capable of, and quite frankly, we’re nowhere near prepared for it."

Supreme General Tian swallowed nervously at such words.

Yu Rou faced Yuan with a solemn expression and said, "I started hearing its voice when I turned sixteen. I’ve never even seen my parents’ faces because I was abandoned at birth, so by then, I had already spent my entire life as an orphan."

"The voice taught me about cultivation, making me the first cultivator in the world. Then, it began showing me glimpses into the future. At first, the visions were random and had nothing to do with the invasion, but everything I saw eventually came true."

"Eventually, it showed me the invasion—otherworldly beings descending upon our world, abducting humans, and taking them beyond the sky."

"Although it never communicated with me directly, I could feel its sincere love for us—that it genuinely wanted to protect us. Soon after, the voice bestowed the system upon me."

"Once again, it never told me what to do, but I had a strong feeling that it wanted me to share the system with others... to use it to protect ourselves."

"I created the military and spread the system, eventually creating the world you’re in right now."

"What about the Void Specters? Did they exist in the past as well, or did they suddenly appear out of nowhere?" Yuan asked.

"They existed long before I was even born. However, there were far fewer of them back then. In fact, they were incredibly rare. You might only encounter a handful while traveling from one city to another, and those Void Specters weren’t aggressive, much like the ones in the current Green Zones."

"However, as time passed, their numbers began to grow, and they gradually became more aggressive... Because of that, travel between the cities eventually became impossible, and we remained isolated from one another until teleporters were created. And once again, the knowledge required to create them was bestowed upon me by the voice."

Yuan pondered everything Yu Rou had told him for some time before finally speaking.

"So, the voice warned you about the invasion and even gave you the means to prepare for it... Yet despite all that preparation and knowledge, you still ended up in this predicament."

He paused briefly before asking, "That vision you recently saw... was I in it?"

Yu Rou shook her head.

"No."

’No? Then either the Eternal couldn’t see the future where I showed up, or...’ Yuan considered many possibilities inwardly.

"Can you contact the Eternal?" Yuan then asked. "If you weren’t the one who spoke to me through the system, then it must’ve been its actual creator—the voice."

However, Yu Rou shook her head again.

"No, I have no way of contacting them. Like I told you, the communication only goes one way, and I receive their messages at random."

"There’s definitely a way to contact them."

"Well, if you know how, do you mind sharing?"

Yuan shook his head and sighed. "Unfortunately, every Eternal has their own method of communication. That said, the next time it reaches out to you, try speaking back to it."

"You think I haven’t tried that before? It never responds."

"It’s probably because you haven’t said anything worth a response. This time, tell them that you know they’re an Eternal and ask for their name."

"...I will try," she said.

A moment later—

"Anyway, let’s talk about why I summoned you. Although I’ve already mentioned it, I want to formally ask for your help with our current predicament. I watched your drill, as well as your last fight with the Void Hunter. That ice power of yours... how long have you had it?"

"I’ve had it even before I arrived in this world," he responded truthfully.

"W-Wait... Are you saying you’ve always been that strong? That you’ve only been pretending to improve this entire time?!" Supreme General Tian couldn’t help but exclaim after hearing Yuan’s words.

"Of course not. I wasn’t faking my strength or pretending to improve—at least, not entirely. The power you witnessed comes from a technique that can only be used with a certain type of energy—the very energy from which Limitless is extracted," Yuan revealed.

"Infinity," Yu Rou suddenly said. "That’s what we call it."

"Seriously? Even though what you extract from it is inferior and already called Limitless?" Yuan remarked with raised eyebrows.

"We call it Limitless because of its limitless capabilities. As for Infinity... it sounds stronger than Limitless, so..." Yu Rou explained their naming sense with a nonchalant shrug.
